# Setting Up Your Group Repository {.unnumbered}

<!-- AI-EDIT(2026-06-11): TF-016, MIT-047, MIT-167, TF-057 — needs review -->
This page supports **Milestone 0 (group formation)** --- see the [M0 README](../../milestones/m0-group-formation/README.md) for the full deliverables. Your group does not create a blank repository from scratch: you start from the group project template.

<!-- AI-EDIT(2026-10-06): M0 fork -> template — the group repo is created with "Use this template" (private), not a fork, to match the HDSx-project-template README; a fork of the public template stays public and its PRs default to the template — needs review -->
1.  **Create from the template:** One member opens the [group project template](https://github.com/ehsanx/HDSx-project-template) (also linked from Canvas) and clicks **Use this template → Create a new repository**. Set yourself as the owner, name the repository for your group, and choose **Private**. The new repository is the group's own copy of the template. Do not fork the template: a fork of a public repository stays public, and its pull requests point back at the course template by default.
2.  **Invite:** That member adds the other teammates as collaborators (**Settings → Collaborators**) on the group repository, and adds the teaching team as instructed on Canvas; others accept the invite.
3.  **Clone:** Everyone launches their own Codespace from the group repository.
4.  **Norms:** Agree: "No direct pushes to `main`" --- all changes go through branches and pull requests.
5.  **Test:** Everyone makes a small `README.md` update (for example, add your name) to verify access.
